sources.title: Qwen 72B · Models · Dataloop
sources.snippet: Qwen-72B is a large language model developed by Alibaba Cloud, boasting 72 billion parameters. It's trained on a massive dataset of over 3 trillion tokens, covering various languages, including Chinese, English, and multiple others.

sources.title: Qwen2.5 72B Instruct API & Playground | Fireworks AI
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5 are a series of decoder-only language models developed by Qwen team, Alibaba Cloud, available in 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B sizes, and base and instruct variants.

sources.title: Qwen2.5 72B API: Pricing, Benchmarks & Docs | Together AI
sources.snippet: Powerful decoder-only models available in 7B and 72B variants, developed by Alibaba Cloud's Qwen team for advanced language processing.

sources.title: 400+ AI Model APIs - DeepSeek, Qwen, Claude, GPT, Flux | Atlas Cloud
sources.snippet: Access 400+ AI models through one unified API. Compare DeepSeek, Qwen, Claude, GPT, Flux, Gemini, LLaMA, Mistral. One API key for all models. OpenAI-compatible endpoints, instant access, no minimum spend.
